sloka: अत्र सा मृगशावाक्षी मत्कृते जनकात्मजा ।पीड्यते शोकसन्तप्ता कृशा स्थण्डिलशायिनी ।। ६.४२.८ ।।।।
transliteration: atra sā mṛgaśāvākṣī matkṛte janakātmajā ।pīḍyate śokasantaptā kṛśā sthaṇḍilaśāyinī ।। 6.42.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "Here (Lanka) is the daughter of Janaka, immersed in sorrow because of me, tormented and emaciated without food and struggling."
